paragraphs: Route creation for The Paddle Games used to be me guessing at a map. I built a Claude Code skill that reads the GPS activity stream instead. Thousands of tracks from connected paddlers were sitting in Firestore. They knew where people launched.

It clusters tracks into launches, destinations, and corridors, ranks regions by distinct paddlers vs existing coverage, and auto-creates disabled draft routes via the admin API. One human review step before anything commits.

The part I didn't anticipate: spatial centroids land in the water. The fix is shore snapping via OSM Overpass, querying boat ramps, beaches, and piers. Getting those Overpass QL queries right took longer than the clustering.
If you paddle (SUP, kayak, canoe, surf, row, or anything), connect your Strava account and join at thepaddlegames.com.
